integration_scheme: Merge backend d4ab390 without replacing working native hooks.
Independent surface policy -> owner+single-video binding -> backend parts mask and cancellation token.
Trusted custom title updates only an isolated typed title value; incompatible ranges are discarded while component styling remains native.
Decoded custom image is encoded into bounded ImageSource.imageData2 in the copied static thumbnail; no downloader callback/signature assumptions or remote-original cache collision.
Keep native original immutable; update generation/revisions on reuse/settings/foreground; asynchronously reload only a still-matching row.
Unknown, ad, live, Shorts, multi-video, shared raw-pointer and unverified template roots pass through with bounded checkpoints.
Compare original serialized source snapshot as well as entry, owner, index, generation, settings and backend revision before accepting callbacks or native refreshes.
limitations: Runtime/server template versions outside the pinned bundle still require a separate profile.
SharedComponentType raw-pointer instances are not writable serialized models; no raw C++ pointer mutation.
Static template evidence establishes roles, not device-visible success.
Downloaded/entity-only roots need an explicit item identity contract.
semantic_slot_policy: For the pinned video_with_context_slots template, validated optional headline_slot/thumbnail_slot/compact_thumbnail_slot overrides are removed only in the isolated presentation model when the corresponding trusted replacement is usable, selecting the verified native metadata/thumbnail fallback branches.
